 David Montgomery (groin) trending in right direction 
 by Ari Koslow | Texans Correspondent | Tue, Nov 17th 2026, 11:49am EST 
 David Montgomery is trending in the right direction and "moving a lot better." ( Aaron Wilson on Twitter ) 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Montgomery could be in line for a workhorse role on Thursday if he is cleared with Woody Marks (concussion) ruled out. He'll need to continue to be monitored in practice. 
 #Texans running back David Montgomery (groin) is feeling and moving a lot better. Trending in right direction after being out since getting hurt vs. #Titans 
Texans still sidelined include Danielle Hunter and Marvin Harrison Jr. with hamstring injuries. Woody Marks is in… https://t.co/jscFLoQ5tW 
— Aaron Wilson (@AaronWilson_NFL) November 17, 2026
